# SB-1033 Safety bulletin: airborne dust from blasting

Revision: Rev E  
Plant: P3, line P3-L1  
Equipment: EQ-P3-L1-SB02

Hazard description
The shot blast operation in the Hot Forge generates airborne particulate that can accumulate on ledges and in ductwork, increasing inhalation and combustible dust risk. Recent inspections identified liner wear and disturbed deposits proximate to the blast wheel that increase dust liberation during operation. Airborne dust exposure can cause respiratory irritation and, under accumulation, presents a fire/explosion hazard in confined spaces and ventilation systems. This bulletin communicates control measures for immediate implementation and references required follow-up actions.

Affected equipment
This bulletin applies to Hot Forge shot blast cabinet EQ-P3-L1-SB02 located on line P3-L1 in plant P3. It also applies to associated collection hoods, ducts, and local access platforms tied to EQ-P3-L1-SB02. Refer to MM-P3-L1-SB02 for maintenance history and SOP-P3-L1-02 and SOP-P3-L1-03 for operator and cleaning procedures.

Required controls
- Inspect blast wheel liner attachment and torque per maintenance record: the blast wheel liner bolt torque for Hot Forge shot blast cabinet #2 (EQ-P3-L1-SB02) is 65 N·m. Verify torque during next planned maintenance and after any liner replacement.  
- Implement enhanced housekeeping around EQ-P3-L1-SB02: remove settled dust from external surfaces and access platforms using vacuum systems specified in SOP-P3-L1-03; avoid dry sweeping.  
- Ensure source capture and filtration are operating to design performance; tag and remove units out of specification and initiate repairs referenced in MM-P3-L1-SB02.  
- Update operator prestart checks in SOP-P3-L1-02 to include visual liner condition and dust accumulation checkpoints; suspend operation if visible liner failure or excessive loose dust is present.  
- Train affected personnel on hazards and controls, and document completion consistent with SOP-P3-L1-02.

Effective date
This bulletin is effective immediately upon issue. All required controls must be implemented without delay and documented per MM-P3-L1-SB02 and SOP-P3-L1-02.
